hunks.before:
jobs:
  host-native-smoke:
    if: github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch' || !inputs.host_only || inputs.target != 'darwin-arm64'
    name: Native host smoke (${{ matrix.target }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 30

npm/native/.artifacts/native/build-token-receipt.json

  fresh-install-smoke:
    if: github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch' || !inputs.host_only || inputs.target != 'darwin-arm64'
    name: Fresh install smoke (${{ matrix.platform.target }}, Node ${{ matrix.node-version }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.platform.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 45

msvc_arch: arm64
    env:
      NODE_OPTIONS: "--disable-warning=DEP0040 --disable-warning=DEP0169"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6
      - name: Setup runtime package managers
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-runtime-package-managers
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
      - name: Setup MSVC toolchain (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        uses: ilammy/msvc-dev-cmd@0b201ec74fa43914dc39ae48a89fd1d8cb592756 # v1
        with:
          arch: ${{ matrix.platform.msvc_arch }}
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@d1031067263f94b142dd6c0ce24c5eb9d02d52a0 # stable
        with: { toolchain: stable }
      - uses: wild-linker/action@0bbbfa5df4380cab8e63cb8505a1ce65e1d10203 # v0.9.0
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        with:

--filter './npm/native...' \
            --filter './npm/cli...' \
            --filter './npm/builder/vite...'
      - name: Build @vizejs/native
        run: vp run --filter './npm/native' build:ci
      - name: Prepare native platform packages
        shell: bash
        working-directory: npm/native

- name: Fresh install and runtime smoke published tarballs
        shell: bash
        run: |
          rust-script --force tools/commands/release/npm/smoke-release-install.rs --prepare-manifests --runtime-checks \
            npm/native npm/native/npm/* \
            npm/cli npm/builder/vite

  selected-host-native-producer:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.host_only && inputs.target == 'darwin-arm64'
hunks.after:
- name: Fresh install and runtime smoke published tarballs
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if [ -n "${PACKED_CONFIG_OUTPUT:-}" ]; then
            set -euo pipefail
            rust-script --force tools/commands/release/npm/smoke-release-install.rs --prepare-manifests --runtime-checks --keep-temp \
              npm/native npm/native/npm/* \
              npm/cli npm/builder/vite 2>&1 | tee "$PACKED_CONFIG_OUTPUT/runtime.log"
          else
            rust-script --force tools/commands/release/npm/smoke-release-install.rs --prepare-manifests --runtime-checks \
              npm/native npm/native/npm/* \
              npm/cli npm/builder/vite
          fi
      - name: Bind installed native images to the selected source producer
        if: always() && env.PACKED_CONFIG_OUTPUT != ''
        run: node tools/support/compat/npm/smoke-release-config-evidence.ts collect
      - name: Preserve complete selected packed configuration evidence
        if: always() && env.PACKED_CONFIG_OUTPUT != ''
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7
        with:
          name: packed-config-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          include-hidden-files: true
          path: |
            ${{ env.PACKED_CONFIG_OUTPUT }}
            npm/native/.artifacts/native/build-token-receipt.json

  selected-host-native-producer:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.host_only && inputs.target == 'darwin-arm64'

msvc_arch: amd64
    env: *native-host-env
    steps: *native-host-steps

  packed-config-acceptance:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.target == 'packed-config'
    name: Packed configuration acceptance (linux-x64-gnu, Node24)
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: ["24"]
        platform:
          - runner: ubuntu-22.04
            target: linux-x64-gnu
            msvc_arch: amd64
    env:
      NODE_OPTIONS: "--disable-warning=DEP0040 --disable-warning=DEP0169"
      PACKED_CONFIG_MODE: "true"
      PACKED_CONFIG_EXPECTED_SOURCE: ${{ inputs.expected_source_sha }}
      PACKED_CONFIG_HOST_ONLY: ${{ inputs.host_only }}
      # Updated only when the reviewed producer is deliberately frozen again.
      PACKED_CONFIG_PRODUCER: 354c1b4a054c0a727d839d08dc134e72a21819c4
    steps: *fresh-install-steps
